name: Bikyaku Reijou Yuuna "Ashi mo Oshiri mo Konna ni Yogosu Nante... Zettai ni Yurusanai!"
original_name: 美脚隷嬢優奈「脚もお尻もこんなに穢すなんて……絶対に許さない！」
source:
Masato is a personal butler of Yuna. He works hard for her, but he is actually in love with her. One day, he sees her wearing wedding dress and realizes; "Oh, she is gonna marry some day...".

Days later, she tells him "There are lots of people to replace you!" when he makes a mistake.

There he swears to himself, "OK, I'll show you. I'll do whatever is necessary to get you...".

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
正人是优奈的私人管家。他努力为她工作，实际上也深爱着她。某天，他看见她身穿婚纱，突然意识到：“啊，她总有一天会嫁人的……”

几天后，正人犯了错，她对他说：“想代替你的人多得是！”

于是他暗自发誓：“好，那我就让你看看。为了得到你，我什么都做得出来……”

[编辑自ErogeShop]
